subject: Upcoming Team Meeting - Please Confirm Attendance
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I would like to remind you about our upcoming team meeting scheduled for next Monday at 10:00 AM in the conference room. It is important that everyone attends to discuss the new project timeline and share updates. Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email. Thank you and looking forward to seeing you all there. Best regards, [Your Name]
